_about: Settings for npm run models. 'defaults' apply to every model; a model's own entry (keyed by its file name in models-src/) overrides them. Each entry's 'changes' is the record of what we altered, which CC BY asks us to state.

defaults._textureSize: Longest side in pixels, per texture slot. Colour and normal carry the fabric detail; roughness, metalness and occlusion read the same at half size.
